answer_plain: Splitting one heavy downpour into four smaller showers lowers hydrogen uptake over two weeks by about 63 % (by 2.8 to 100 %), so uptake goes down in every case we tried. Splitting the same total rain into daily drizzle lowers uptake by almost 100 % (by 51 to 100 %). A single soaking pushes water deeper into the sand so microbes stay active for more days before surface evaporation dries the top layer.
answer_science: Central percentage change: h2_uptake_change_pct = -63.24 % (median -68.65 %, 50 % IQR [-93.21, -37.95] %, joint 5–95 % interval [-100, -2.766] %) (rounded headline: 63 %); absolute change h2_uptake_contrast_umol_m2 = -697.1 µmol m⁻² (median -441.4 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [-1061, -165.8] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [-2343, -30.2] µmol m⁻²); absolute uptake h2_uptake_umol_m2 = 405.2 µmol m⁻² (median 204.1 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [31.28, 940.9] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [0, 3950] µmol m⁻²) (mode = variance, refusal fraction = 0.0 %, max level refusal across question = 0.0 %). Daily drizzle (12 mm total) vs one 12 mm storm: h2_uptake_change_pct = -99.74 % (median -99.93 %, 50 % IQR [-100, -90.7] %, joint 5–95 % interval [-100, -50.87] %) (plain: almost 100 % reduction); h2_uptake_contrast_umol_m2 = -1099 µmol m⁻² (median -834.9 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [-1969, -300.8] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [-3933, -121] µmol m⁻²); h2_uptake_umol_m2 = 2.872 µmol m⁻² (median 0.3715 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [0, 99.36] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [0, 1391] µmol m⁻²) (one-storm baseline h2_uptake_umol_m2 = 1102 µmol m⁻² (median 925.6 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [347.7, 2286] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [120.8, 4671] µmol m⁻²)). Top two Sobol' contributors to output variance: retention_b (ST = 0.69 [0.64, 0.74], S1 = 0.63) and psi_entry_mpa (ST = 0.26 [0.23, 0.29], S1 = 0.22). Status share of variance: verified_in_source ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00), modeller_assumption ST = 1.00 (S1 = 1.00), source_not_checked ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00) (joint group total indices can sum to more than 1 because of interactions). Convergence check: at No rain (0 mm) (co_uptake_umol_m2, N = 2048), interval endpoints still move by 6.3 % of the width between N/2 and N; at No rain (0 mm) (h2_uptake_umol_m2, N = 2048), interval endpoints still move by 8.2 % of the width between N/2 and N; at Daily drizzle (12 mm total) (h2_uptake_umol_m2, N = 2048), interval endpoints still move by 10.3 % of the width between N/2 and N. Limits: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error.
